description: Routes explicitly confirmed, structured G2 or Meta voice commands to assigned ground robots, approved local smart plugs, and the separately armed Tello fleet. The glasses never emit vendor packets or free-form physical values.
fallbackBehavior: Report each unavailable output independently. Ground adapters stop through their local watchdog; takeoff remains dormant until a tutor separately arms the fleet controller; a land or plug-off request never requires an LLM interpretation.
